A Rift-touched umber hulk whose confusion gaze channels raw Veil chaos — victims don't simply become disoriented; they briefly perceive the overlapping realities bleeding through the Rift. Those who survive the experience are never quite the same. Umber hulks carve new tunnels through the underdark, drawn by some instinct toward dormant Anchor Doors.
## Traits
**Confusing Gaze.** When a creature starts its turn within 30 feet and can see the rift umber hulk's eyes, the rift umber hulk can force DC 15 CHA save or the target can't take reactions and rolls a d8 to determine action (1: attack rift umber hulk, 2-3: do nothing, 4-5: attack nearest, 6-7: flee, 8: act normally). Lasts until start of next turn.
**Tunneler.** Burrow through solid rift rock at half burrow speed, leaving a 5-foot-wide, 8-foot-tall tunnel.

## Actions
**Multiattack.** Two claw attacks.
**Claw.** +8 to hit, 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing.
